Cookies for the key cabinet inside the VPN connection

cabinet.dataNote: We do not need this data ourselves, but it is the minimum set required by law for requests from authorities in VPN server jurisdictions. All data is encrypted with a key split across the team per day and per squad so the key can only be decrypted with majority consent of key holders, and only what is requested will be decrypted.

faq.question: How do I see how much traffic I have left?
answers: The remainder is shown on your user card (the first card in the list)

faq.question: How can a user know how much traffic they have left?
answers: They ask you, and you check their card

faq.question: Which country is my server in?
answers: Definitely outside Russia/Belarus, in a country with rule of law. We know exactly where yours is, but we will not tell you :)

faq.question: How much traffic do I get in total?
answers: Each user gets 100 GB. Limits reset at the start of each month.
If you are SUPER-VIP with an unlimited key — full freedom, no caps.

faq.question: How many devices can connect to one key cabinet?
answers: One key cabinet can hold up to 250 configs at once. If you are nearing the limit, remove inactive users (see statuses “dead soul” and “hedgehog in the fog”).

faq.question: Can I choose the country I connect to?
answers: Not in the current version. Our focus is your safety; we rotate IPs regularly.

faq.question: What if someone gets my name and six words or my file — what happens to me, my squad, and you?
answers: If a stranger gets your login and six words, they can reissue the brigadier config. The old one is disabled immediately and you lose the squad.
Users you added may be deleted. IPs could theoretically be enriched via providers, but outsiders still cannot see traffic.

faq.question: What if I forgot/lost the six magic words and/or brigadier name? What happens to my users?
answers: If you are reading this here, your username is on the first card.
No one can restore the six words — not even with a puppy held hostage.
You can manage the squad until you lose the config file. Support can use the brigadier name.
If the file is gone, the squad is on its own; you cannot help those you shared configs with.
We suggest reissuing the squad and redistributing keys — your choice :)
